assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite sheet for Greyline side-view tactical war game. ONE 105mm LIGHT TOWED HOWITZER ONLY, mechanically believable M101-style small twin-wheel gun with long rear split towing trails, shield on carriage, facing RIGHT in perfectly orthographic side elevation, no perspective. Canvas square 1024x1024, transparent background. TWO separate isolated painted components with generous empty gap: TOP HALF y30..490 contains ONLY fixed lower carriage, wheels, spades, shield and an empty round trunnion socket at front upper shield; absolutely NO barrel, NO breech, NO recoil cylinders on this fixed component. BOTTOM HALF y580..900 contains one complete MOBILE GUN ASSEMBLY oriented perfectly HORIZONTAL: breech at left, short recoil cylinders above the long gun tube, muzzle at right, no wheels/shield. Assembly rotates together about breech/trunnion when animated. Both components use same side profile and matching physical scale. Detailed grim military PIXEL ART, clearly visible 3-4 pixel clusters, restrained weathered olive steel, dark outline, readable military shape at 170px width, coherent proportions, no toy proportions, no haze, no reflections, no labels, no scenery, no humans, no cast ground shadow. Not a card illustration. The lower gun assembly must be perfectly level, NOT angled upward.

Use case stylized-concept. One production modular sprite sheet, 1280x1280 transparent. Subject: small 60mm light mortar: small circular baseplate, slender simple two-leg bipod and narrow long smooth tube. This is an INFANTRY MORTAR, absolutely NOT a howitzer, cannon or wheel carriage. Two components separated vertically: TOP y80..650 only baseplate and bipod legs, no gun tube, no shield, no tyres, no recoil mechanism. Flat baseplate sits at left rear, small bipod at right front. BOTTOM y820..1150 one complete long plain HORIZONTAL mortar tube, closed base/socket at LEFT, open muzzle at RIGHT, no cannon muzzle brake, no recuperator. A mortar rotates from its baseplate socket and aims upward right. Perfectly orthographic side view, facing right. Detailed military PIXEL ART muted olive, weathered steel, crisp medium clusters, simple believable conventional mortar silhouette, no text, no people, no ground shadow. Generous margins. Keep tube perfectly horizontal for separate rotation.
